# Tabler Icons sources

Vendored from [v3.48.0](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/tree/v3.48.0), under the MIT license.

The SVG geometry is unchanged. Template wrappers add accessibility attributes and existing theme classes, and retain the 24 × 24 grid and 2px rounded strokes. The default header mark uses `terminal-2`; the favicon places the same geometry on a rounded background.
